notes.title: Roguelike/Dungeon Crawler Big Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
A major update is coming soon, replacing arena survival with a roguelike dungeon crawler. 

What is now:

 A hideout where you could buy items and upgrade perks
 An arena in which the positions and numbers of doors and mechanisms were randomly generated

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38706570/90aec63e1f2da6c9484c4ec8c929a4ab39d80670.gif

What will be in the future:

 A procedurally generated dungeon where you can explore various rooms and secret areas
 Inventory (the hideout will be removed, perks will be replaced with items with passive abilities)
 Destructible objects, chests, keys, closed doors
 Some of the powerful magic will be used through throwing objects (tornado, fire dragons, etc.)
 And other classic roguelike and dungeon crawler features

notes.title: Brutal Wizardry Update v1.0.9 Released
notes.notes:
Improvements

 Reduced the number of kills to finish level and the maximum number of creatures on W-I and W-II to make it easier for beginners to start the game
 Added advices on first level


Fixes

 Fixed reverse weapon right hand wrong spawner position
 Fixed when you are gettings access to secret stuff when it's not revealed yet in NG+
 Fixed when flying creatures on boss 3 was not spawned in NG+
 Fixed when some perks shows wrong info about current stats

notes.title: Brutal Wizardry Update v1.0.4 Released
notes.notes:
This update is more about making it easier for new players to get into the game. Since many things turned out to be not intuitive, I decided to describe in the tutorial how some mechanics works and about some non-obvious things (for example, there are destructible walls at the levels, behind which there are hidden mechanisms and weapons).

Improvements

 Added new text information to the tutorial tab
 Added animations with demonstrations to the tutorial descriptions
 Reduced the cost of wands by 30%
 Now instead of 800 gold at the start, you get 2 wands
 Now teleport does not cost 1 hp as before
 Now you can destroy destructible walls with grabbed enemies
